name: scenario-pack
title: Scenario review pack
for_each: select id,code from scenarios order by code

sections.title: Department capacity and annual cost
sections.note: Full-time annual rate multiplied by position FTE. Currencies are separate. This is a planning estimate, not payroll.
sections.sql: select department,currency,positions,fte,vacant_fte,annual_cost_amount from department_costs where scenario_id=$1 order by department,currency

sections.title: Positions
sections.sql: select code,title,department,fte,currency,annual_cost_amount from position_costs where scenario_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select rule,finding from review_findings where scenario_id=$1 order by rule

name: decision-record
title: Planning review record
for_each: select id,code from scenarios order by code

sections.title: Review status
sections.note: Approval records a scenario review. It does not authorise an employment change.

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,closed_on,evidence from actions where scenario_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Activity
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from events where scenario_id=$1 order by created_at,id
